basic_info.description: 236 Laussat Street, ideally situated between Steiner and Fillmore Streets in one of the most coveted San Francisco's neighborhoods in Lower Haight. The building offers six 1Br/1Ba units with two units currently combined as one 4Br/2Ba unit.   The units have ample sunlight, wood floors and period details. Several units has been remodeled with granite counters and stainless appliances. It has a separate PG&E meters, ground floor storage and a two car parking garage.  Located in the heart of San Francisco, Lower Haight is well-connected by public transportation, has great to proximity to parks and thriving restaurant, nightlife and entertainment options.  This is a probate sale, subject to court confirmation. Offer date 7/31/24.  Please call for details.
